integrity: The Hom-Lie structure is verified as a Yau twist, and both the twist-commutation and embedding-tensor equations are reconstructed directly. All three parameter fibers are solved symbolically. A standalone checker exhaustively tests every matrix over F2 and F3 and replays the closed rank formulas over additional fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the one-parameter Yau-twist family alpha_lambda=diag(1,lambda,lambda) on the three-dimensional Heisenberg algebra.
No quotient by Hom-Lie automorphisms is computed.
The primary source assumes characteristic zero; the finite-field extension is independently proved from the defining polynomial identities.
title: Adjoint embedding tensors on a one-parameter Hom-Heisenberg family
